rv.t: If you're a fan of Lesbians, Mysteries, Mysterious Lesbians, Girls with various interesting things wrong with them, and/or the visual novel Umineko When They Cry. Then you should play this. Very soon. Please?

The genuinely excellent characters dominate most of the impressions I see but I'd like to draw attention to the ways in which this game resolves some persistent issues with the Ace Attorney formula. …
不错，适合用于练习英语阅读和词汇量的小说，角色挺有意思的，剧情比较有趣
